views.title: 전체 조감도
views.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE high quality wide landscape image, view 01 of a coherent Korean highway rest-stop environment design set for later Blender modeling. This is a reference-grounded 3D concept, not a poster. The attached 4 contact sheets are source references from the user's PPT: use the real low elongated Korean service building and front parking organization from sheet1, the snack promenade/food court from sheet2, the single-story charcoal roof with yellow fascia, transparent repeating arched pedestrian canopy and red fuel canopy from sheet3, the dedicated restroom wing from sheet4. Synthesize, do not copy any watermark, news captions, brand logos, people or presentation borders.
Show one complete coherent believable rest stop in a high front-left three-quarter aerial architectural view, entire site comfortably framed. Hero building at back: one story, long shallow charcoal gabled metal roof with muted ochre yellow trim, pale warm stone walls, central taller glazed food-hall entrance, timber framed snack counters to the left, independent connected lower restroom wing to right. Thin translucent curved canopy with straight white columns along the front pedestrian promenade; keep entrance and shop facade visible beneath it. Broad gray tiled forecourt, separate zebra crossing to a realistically proportioned asphalt parking lot, 3 rows with roughly 24 spaces and just 4 parked vehicles. Fuel station on far left near entry: low RED canopy, WHITE supporting columns, two pump islands and a small store. Clearly distinct from food building. Small grass islands, clipped trees, 3 benches, red vending pair near building; woodland hills as quiet background. Looping entry/exit lanes, safe uninterrupted pedestrian route. Keep all construction human scale with convincing curb heights and separately legible parts.
Style: polished stylized 3D game environment, Blender architectural diorama feel, soft bevels, simple readable physically plausible shapes, restrained clean materials, subtle fine texture, natural neutral daylight and soft ambient shadows. NO exaggerated toy proportions, no photorealistic grime, no floating slabs, no random repeated sheds, no fantasy amusement park, no monumental giant building, no huge empty runway. Warm wood/cream walls/charcoal roof/yellow trim, red only fuel and vending accents. Only limited architectural signage: "휴게소" at main entrance, "식당" on food court, "화장실" on right wing, "주유소" on fuel canopy. No page titles, no arrows, no UI, no annotations. 16:9 landscape.

views.title: 정면과 간식 거리
views.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Produce one landscape architectural 3D concept image, second view of THE SAME Korean highway rest stop in reference image1. Image1 is the approved-for-continuity visual anchor for this generation (not a user approval claim); images2 and3 are PPT visual references for snack counter detailing. Preserve the anchor building identity exactly: one-story long charcoal shallow gabled roof, warm yellow edge, cream stone piers, warm wood infill, central glazed entrance under its raised gable, low restroom wing to right and thin translucent repeated arched canopy on white posts. Preserve sunny natural daylight and restrained clean 3D materials.
Move camera to human height 1.7m on the front pavement, looking diagonally from left snack frontage toward the central glass entrance and right restroom connection, 30mm architectural lens with upright verticals. Make the snack frontage the subject: three integrated under-eave exterior service bays with readable separate stainless-and-wood counters, modest curved glass display cabinets, a compact fryer, stacked serving trays and small illustrated food menus. Signs above bays say only "호두과자", "간식", "커피". Counters form the left front wall of the same building, not freestanding unrelated carts. One small bench, pair of red vending machines toward the central entrance, tree planters and paved yellow tactile guidance stripe, broad unobstructed 5m pedestrian route under the canopy. Road/one crosswalk visible along bottom-left edge. Sufficient empty walking area to read spatial construction. No people, no characters, no product advertising, no news graphics, no labels or explanation outside the architectural signage. Soft bevels, clean readable game environment geometry, detailed enough for Blender construction reference, realistic construction and consistent human scale. Not a flat elevation. Single frame, 16:9.

views.title: 식당과 실내 방어전 공간
views.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Produce one landscape 3D interior architectural concept for THE SAME Korean highway rest-stop building seen in input1, with food-hall layout/detail reference from input2 (user PPT). Same cream warm stone, warm wooden fascia, ochre accents, charcoal structural ribs, central glazed entrance and restrained clean Blender-render materials. View from an elevated interior front corner at 3.6m eye level, looking across a wide rectangular single-story FOOD HALL, 24mm architectural camera, verticals straight. See one continuous coherent room with a moderate-height pale ceiling and clean slim dark roof beams; upper skylight brings daylight, front-side glazing shows the forecourt.
Key layout: a generous central square of completely clear tiled floor (roughly 10m by 12m as conceptual scale only), connected to wide crossing circulation aisles. Keep 8 rectangular wood dining tables with 4 chairs each in two perimeter dining strips, organized and believable; do not fill center with tables. Food service counters along back and left walls, each with a separate glass serving cabinet, register, tidy utensils and a small overhead Korean menu sign: "한식", "우동", "돈가스", "커피". Large entrance at near side, side passage at right with "화장실" sign and another unobstructed opening left, providing legible approaches suitable for a later stationary-defense game space. No arena markings, no barricades, no game UI, no arrows. Benches/planters modest, no clutter in sightlines. Clearly distinguish counters, seating zones, and center circulation. The room must feel like a genuine Korean roadside restaurant, not a shopping mall, airport hangar or medieval tavern. No people, no combat, no watermarks. Soft daylight, soft bevels, readable game-ready design language; no claim of actual game implementation. One single coherent frame, 16:9.

views.title: 화장실 동선과 구조
views.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one coherent 3D architectural CUTAWAY of the low restroom wing at the right end of the Korean rest stop in input1. Input2 is the user's direct PPT reference for real Korean public restroom details. Keep cream stone external walls and dark thin roof material from input1, warm oak doors and partition panels, gray floor tiles, pale cream wall tiles and a modest reddish-brown brick accent wall like the PPT. Render one physically believable rectangular restroom block alone, viewed from front-right at a high 40-degree three-quarter angle on plain warm light-gray studio background. A dollhouse cutaway: remove roof and ONLY the camera-facing exterior walls, retaining the structural back and side walls; no exploded floating roof. Front entrance vestibule with sign "화장실" and male/female/accessibility pictograms feeds two physically separated rooms via clear doorways. Right-hand men's room: 3 separate wall-mounted white urinals with small divider panels along the back wall, 2 proper opaque toilet cubicles on the far right, sinks with mirror along a side wall near entry. Left-hand women's room: 4 enclosed opaque toilet cubicles with doors on one side, shared sink-and-mirror counter near its entry. Keep a solid full-height dividing wall between male/female rooms, and entrances with turning privacy screens so no direct view from exterior to fixtures. One separate accessible single-user cubicle near entrance, visually plausible size and doorway. Distinct passageways, every fixture reachable, no impossible overlapping objects; preserve plumbing fixture scale. Soft daylight through high windows, neutral studio fill, readable bevels and separate modeling components, restrained materials, no tiny clutter. No people, no text labels or dimensions around model, no brands/watermarks/game UI, not photorealistic toilets advertising. One single standalone cutaway model frame, landscape 16:9, comfortably framed with margins.

views.title: 주유소와 진입 구역
views.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate one landscape 3D environment concept of the fuel station belonging to EXACTLY THE SAME rest stop in input1. Use the fuel-station construction visible in user PPT sheet input2 as detailing support. Retain input1's simple wide RED rectangular fuel canopy with thin pale-gray top, WHITE square structural posts, two physically separate pump islands, low cream service shop behind. Front three-quarter human-scale architectural view from the entering lane, eye height about 2.5m, 35mm lens; entire canopy, pumps and service hut fit comfortably in the frame. Two islands each with two clean white fuel dispensers, black hoses, red lower accent, impact bollards; properly open vehicle approach lanes, honest hose and nozzle shapes, clear ground contact. One compact white car fueling on far bay for scale, one tidy wall-mounted fire extinguisher cabinet, a compact tire air-service unit beside service shop. Tidy gray concrete forecourt, asphalt entry curve, yellow lane edge and white directional arrow, narrow planted separator. Show the previously established long charcoal-roof, warm yellow-fascia, glass-front main food/restroom building in the mid-distance on the RIGHT, smaller and unobtrusive, consistent with fuel station being on its left. Forest hills beyond, sunny clean daylight matching input1. Architectural signs only: canopy "주유소", service shop "편의점". No real oil company logos, no price numbers, no sales banners, no people, no page titles. Clean slightly simplified Blender architectural environment render, buildable separated geometry, restrained texture and soft beveled edges. No giant highway plaza, no fantasy objects, no collisions between car and pumps. Single frame, 16:9.

views.title: 분리 제작용 주요 모듈
views.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a clean production-oriented 3D MODEL COMPONENT REFERENCE BOARD for the Korean rest stop in inputs1–3. These anchor the same design and material family. Input4 is the user's PPT evidence for component construction. Exactly EIGHT distinct isolated assemblies on a seamless light gray background, arranged in a generous 4-column by 2-row layout, with no graphic borders, no text captions, no numbers, no colored UI cards. Every object fully visible with large clean gaps, not touching or overlapping; common 30-degree three-quarter viewing angle, soft studio lighting, subtle ground shadows. Object scale may vary per cell for readability, but parts inside each assembly have honest proportions. Slightly simplified polished Blender game asset appearance with crisp construction and soft bevels.
TOP ROW left to right:
1. One complete warm-wood snack COUNTER STALL module from reference2, including a flat overhead fascia (blank sign panel), glass pastry cabinet, stainless countertop, simple back wall and compact register, no attached building.
2. ONE span of the distinctive arched translucent pedestrian CANOPY with white straight posts and curved ribs from reference1, no attached building, all support posts visible.
3. ONE clean white-and-red FUEL DISPENSER on a narrow low concrete base, black looped hose and properly modeled nozzle on the side, no full petrol canopy.
4. A PAIR of RED VENDING MACHINES, different drinks/snack fronts, standing separately a small gap apart, no brand text.
BOTTOM ROW left to right:
5. One rectangular warm oak DINING TABLE with exactly FOUR separately legible mustard/olive chairs, matching reference3.
6. One freestanding wood-slat BENCH with dark metal legs from reference2, normal seat proportions.
7. One square pale stone PLANTER with one small clipped green tree and low shrubs, plausible root volume.
8. One standalone public-restroom SINK AND MIRROR wall module, 3 separate white basins, metal faucets, warm stone backsplash, three clearly separate mirrors, no toilets.
Every assembly recognizable at thumbnail size, no messy excessive small objects. Keep charcoal metal / cream stone / warm wood / ochre accents and red only vending/fuel details. No people, no vehicles, no page heading, no watermarks. This is a reference board for later separate modeling, not a single combined mesh. Wide landscape 16:9.
